text:
This is a truely beautiful flower! Great bag appeal the buds are well formed, frosty and dense, but also have a nice spongey bounce to them. 

Smell wise, I'm definitely getting those z terps coming through along with a nice bit of sweetness.

It 'vapes' beautifully. Lovely taste, very smooth, very clean.

For me this is a great daytime flower, and one that might possibly become a regular repeat.

This stuff look terrible smells amd tastes , it's certainly not something i would expect from supposedly medical grade cannabis. It smells like hay, it looks like hay, it tastes like hay. But if you can get past all of that, the effects are okay.
Okay but a bit muted, and ive also found a couple of seeds in it. As you can see from the video it's mostly all smalls, which at the price point, is shocking to say the least.
The Smell is very muted, as is the taste. Still medicates okay but overall I'm quite disappointed with this one.

Great strain! It has a pungent gassy smell, a nice taste although a little muted. Abit of gas on the inhale and nice and smooth on the exhale. Unfortunately i did find a few small seeds in this which is rather disappointing at this price point in medical.

All in all though it definitely is one of the better ones.
Lovely zed terpy goodness. This one will be ordered again.
Little smell or taste , improved slightly once left  decanted in to glass jar , looks ok ( very small buds as stated as smalls) good pain relief for me not too heavy.
Smell and taste were average on arrival but improved greatly once decanted in to glass for a while, good day time stain , uplifting affect, good pain control, no paranoia or headache for me.

Excellent flower!
Taste, smell, effects, all on point.
If I was to take price point into account also this would be a 9.5 out of 10. At £65 this is by far the best I've had. Worth every penny.

Excellent flower, id say its a little on the steep side at the £10/g price point but it definitely is one of the better ones on medical upto now. It's been a regular on my script at the £8.5/g mark this would be outstanding.
Decent day time flower, nice pungent smell that leans more towards blue dream than gelato, taste is similar to the smell. At the price point, I'd definitely purchase again.

This strain worked great for my pain, it had a great smell quite orangey id say, looks were spot on taste exactly as expected from the smell. Overall a great strain and will definitely be a repeat for me 👌

Definitely one of the best strains on medical to date imo, it's in my top 3 for sure. Has a nice strong smell, id say it's quite gassy with a menthol back tone personally, And the taste is truly delightful, very similar to te smell. Great for pain, i use it at night time. This ones always on my script when its available 💯
